provisionalNotes: Uses the leftmost seasonal Edible producer and adds +1 to its first successful generation each season this year.

experimentation.authoredEffect: Gain Research and bias the next Scholar Practice/Structure offer upward in Quality.
experimentation.authoredHook: Hard Scholar staffing gate; Ingenuity uplift remains separately visible and price-neutral.

formationTraining.label: Formation Training

formationTraining.authoredEffect: Improve the conversion of local Warrior population into Martial Support, especially for Campaign/Defense.
formationTraining.authoredHook: Future Warrior candidates from this settlement can gain small Prowess development.

veteranInstruction.label: Veteran Instruction

veteranInstruction.authoredEffect: Improve future Warrior candidate development/Prowess progress based on local Warrior population.

charge.dischargeText: Require at least 1 Warrior here. Bank 1 Prowess Development for the next Warrior candidate.

siegeTraining.label: Siege Training

siegeTraining.authoredEffect: Increase civilization Support specifically for Conquest/Retake Campaigns.
siegeTraining.authoredHook: Lets settled/engineering Warrior builds differ from mobile raiders.
provisionalNotes: Supplied Support multiplier is +25%; Birth banks +1 Support. Specialized Conquest/Retake weighting is deferred.

caravanGuarding.label: Caravan Guarding

caravanGuarding.authoredEffect: Banks value from repeated external Trade; on Discharge it generates local Currency/Mobility Stock while supplied.
caravanGuarding.authoredHook: Allows Warrior population to support peaceful exchange as well as raiding.

charge.dischargeText: Require positive local Martial Support. Generate 2 Stock.

provisionalNotes: Secondary hook uses current numeric training/candidate/preview/support grammar; authored choice, Legacy and specialized action variants remain deferred.

rescueParties.label: Rescue Parties

ui.rule: At a shortage or Monster Crisis: Consume 1 [Edible]. Require [Mobility] or [Power]. Rescue up to 5 people into available Housing in a connected friendly settlement.

rescueParties.authoredEffect: Adds a non-conquest option to eligible Crisis incidents: move endangered population/Stock before deterministic loss.
rescueParties.authoredHook: Warrior Vassal may personally join, adding Prowess/Retinue if the response is Dangerous.
provisionalNotes: Real Crisis evacuation moves up to 5 people, preserving specialists, to a connected friendly site with Housing. Stock rescue and personal martial joining are deferred.

forcedMarches.label: Forced Marches

forcedMarches.authoredEffect: Extend how far local Martial Support can contribute to a Campaign or reduce movement time at extra supply cost.
forcedMarches.authoredHook: Prowess still supplies personal Force; this extends civilization contribution.
provisionalNotes: Birth banks +1 local Support. Extra travel/support distance and reduced travel time are deferred.

warbandMarching.label: Warband Marching

warbandMarching.authoredEffect: Allow a capped share of Warrior population from an adjacent friendly settlement to contribute Martial Support.
provisionalNotes: Birth banks coordination for one connected friendly source at 25%, capped at 10 Support.

feastingTheHost.label: Feasting the Host

feastingTheHost.authoredHook: Turns successful raiding into social reproduction rather than only money.

tournaments.label: Tournaments

warCouncil.authoredHook: Future Warrior candidates gain better Campaign target information.

greatHost.authoredEffect: Major build-around: combine a capped share of Martial Support from multiple connected settlements into one external action.
greatHost.authoredHook: Creates late-game conqueror/defender scale without changing the basic Force grammar.
